text: A pipe burst in my kitchen wall during the winter freeze, causing water damage to the plasterboard and flooring. I notified the insurer within 2 days and provided photos.
notes: Sudden, accidental water damage from burst pipe is a standard insurable peril under building coverage.

text: Cyclone Yasmine tore off my roof and damaged the timber frame. The damage occurred in Far North Queensland during the cyclone season. I have photos and council reports.
notes: Cyclone damage in Queensland and Northern Territory is explicitly excluded under HOME-6.1.

text: My sofa and curtains were destroyed in a house fire caused by a neighbour's negligence. I have the fire report and proof of the items destroyed.
notes: Contents damage from fire is covered under standard contents insurance.

text: My television gradually stopped working over 6 months due to normal age and use. I am claiming for the cost of a replacement TV.
notes: Wear and tear and gradual deterioration are explicitly excluded under HOME-5.1.

text: A severe hailstorm destroyed my roof tiles and dented my gutters. I have photos from the day after the storm and a damage assessment report.
notes: Hailstorm damage in South Australia is excluded under HOME-6.3.

text: A bushfire swept through my area and destroyed my deck, garden shed, and fence. I have council evacuation records and photos of the damage.
notes: Bushfire damage in Tasmania is excluded under HOME-6.5.

text: Heavy rainfall caused flooding in my basement, destroying my stored furniture and electrical items. The local area experienced 200mm of rain in 4 hours.
notes: Flood damage is excluded under HOME-5.4 regardless of severity.

text: A severe dust storm blanketed my house, scratching all windows and clogging the air conditioning system. I have photos and a weather bureau report confirming the dust storm.
notes: Severe dust storm damage in Western Australia is excluded under HOME-6.4.

text: A burglar broke into my house and stole my laptop, TV, and jewellery. I have filed a police report and provided the crime reference number.
notes: Theft is a standard insurable peril under contents cover.

text: I deliberately set fire to my garden shed to destroy some old items. I have now filed a claim for the damage.
notes: Intentional damage caused by the insured is excluded under HOME-5.2.

text: Another car hit me at a red light while I was stationary. The other driver admitted fault. I have the police report and third-party details.
notes: Collision damage is a standard insurable event under motor comprehensive cover.

text: My car was caught in a cyclone in Far North Queensland. The windscreen smashed and the body was dented. I have photos and a weather bureau report.
notes: Cyclone damage in Queensland and Northern Territory is excluded under MOTOR-6.1.

text: A bushfire destroyed my parked car while I was evacuating. The vehicle is a total loss. I have evacuation records and fire service photos.
notes: Bushfire damage in Victoria is excluded under MOTOR-6.2.

text: My engine seized because I failed to check the oil level for 18 months. The mechanic says the engine is ruined and needs replacement.
notes: Mechanical breakdown is excluded under MOTOR-5.4, and the failure was due to lack of maintenance.

text: I was racing a friend on a private circuit and crashed into a barrier. My car sustained serious damage. I have photos of the damage.
notes: Racing and speed events are excluded under MOTOR-5.6.

text: My car was parked when heavy rain caused flooding. The engine flooded and the interior was damaged. The local area received 180mm of rain.
notes: Flood damage is excluded under MOTOR-5.5.

text: A tree branch fell on my parked car during a storm, cracking the windscreen. I have photos and the repair quote from a panel beater.
notes: Windscreen and glass damage is covered under MOTOR-4.4.

text: An uninsured driver hit me and drove away. I have the police report and witness statements but no third-party insurance details.
notes: Uninsured motorist protection covers damage caused by uninsured or unidentified drivers.

text: I drove my car into a lake to test whether it would float. The engine is now ruined. I have photos of the incident.
notes: Intentional damage caused by the insured is excluded under MOTOR-5.2.

text: I was driving with a suspended license at the time of the accident. Another car hit me from behind. I have the police report.
notes: Driving with a suspended license constitutes unlawful use, excluded under MOTOR-5.3.

text: I was diagnosed with severe appendicitis while on holiday in Thailand and needed emergency surgery. The hospital bill was $8500. I have medical reports and receipts.
notes: Emergency medical treatment overseas is covered under TRAVEL-4.1.

text: I cancelled my trip to Europe because my mother had a minor cold and I was worried. I am claiming for the full cost of flights and accommodation.
notes: Trip cancellation due to worry about a minor illness is not a covered reason; exclusions apply to non-medical cancellations.

text: My trip to Queensland was cancelled because a cyclone warning was issued for my destination area. I have the cyclone warning and cancellation confirmation.
notes: Cyclone exclusion in Queensland applies; cancellation due to cyclone is excluded under TRAVEL-6.1.

text: I left my luggage on a train in London and it was never recovered. The bag contained clothes, toiletries, and a camera worth $3500 total.
notes: Baggage and personal effects loss is covered under TRAVEL-2.3.

text: I broke my leg while hiking in New Zealand and had to be airlifted by helicopter to hospital. The medical and evacuation costs totalled $22000.
notes: Emergency medical treatment and medical evacuation are covered under TRAVEL-4.1 and TRAVEL-4.2.

text: I missed my flight because I overslept. I am claiming for the cost of rebooking and the lost hotel night.
notes: Trip disruption due to personal negligence is not a covered reason under trip cancellation exclusions.

text: I had a pre-existing heart condition that I did not disclose when buying travel insurance. I had a heart attack while overseas and was hospitalized for $15000.
notes: Pre-existing medical conditions are excluded under TRAVEL-4.3 if not declared.

text: I was injured in a bar fight in Bangkok and had to seek medical treatment. I have the hospital receipt and medical report.
notes: Injury resulting from unlawful activities (assault/brawl) is excluded under TRAVEL-5.2.

text: My house was badly damaged in a break-in where the burglar forced entry. I have the police report but did not notify my insurer until 6 weeks after the incident.
notes: Burglary damage is normally covered, but late notification (6 weeks vs typical 30-day requirement) may breach conditions and prejudice investigation.

text: My car was damaged in a collision. I had the vehicle repaired without waiting for insurer approval. The repair cost was $8500.
notes: Unauthorized repairs may breach MOTOR-7.5 requiring authorization; recovery depends on whether repairs were reasonable and necessary.

text: I cancelled my trip to Europe 3 days before departure because I tested positive for COVID. I have the positive test result and airline cancellation confirmation.
notes: Trip cancellation due to illness (COVID-positive) is a covered reason under TRAVEL-3.1.

text: A kitchen fire destroyed my oven and damaged the cupboards. The fire was caused by a faulty oven element. I have the fire report and repair quote.
notes: Fire damage to building components is covered under HOME-3.1 and HOME-3.2.

text: A passenger in my car was injured in a collision I caused. The passenger is now suing me for medical costs of $18000.
notes: Legal liability for injuries to passengers is covered under MOTOR-4.5.

text: My house was damaged when a tree fell on the roof during a storm. The tree was from my property. I have photos and arborist report.
notes: Storm damage from fallen tree is normally covered as an insurable peril.

text: My roof has been leaking for 2 years due to poor maintenance. I finally got it repaired and am claiming for water damage to the ceiling and walls.
notes: Damage from lack of maintenance and gradual deterioration is excluded under HOME-5.5.

text: My car was damaged in a hailstorm in inland NSW. The hail was severe and dented the entire roof and bonnet. I have photos and weather reports.
notes: Hail damage in inland New South Wales is excluded under MOTOR-6.3.

text: I accidentally spilled red wine on my carpets and curtains. I am claiming for replacement of these items.
notes: Accidental staining and damage from normal use is wear and tear, excluded under HOME-5.1.

text: I lost my wallet containing $2500 cash while sightseeing in Paris. I have the police report from French authorities.
notes: Cash loss is typically excluded as wear and tear or personal negligence, not covered under travel policies.

text: My car was parked when it was hit by another vehicle. The other driver left a note but no insurance details. I later found them and they admitted liability.
notes: Collision damage is covered; third-party liability is established even without immediate insurance details.

text: My property was damaged when a neighbour's tree fell during a storm and destroyed my fence and garden shed. I have photos and proof the tree was from their property.
notes: Damage from third-party negligence (neighbour's tree) is covered under building and contents cover.

text: My house was damaged when I accidentally drove my car through the front wall. I am claiming for the structural damage.
notes: Damage caused by the insured's own negligent act (driving car through wall) is excluded as intentional/reckless damage.

text: My car's air conditioning stopped working. The mechanic says the compressor has failed due to normal wear. I am claiming for replacement.
notes: Wear and tear on mechanical components is excluded under MOTOR-5.1.

text: I needed emergency dental treatment for a severe toothache while on holiday in Bali. The dentist charged $950 for extraction and antibiotics.
notes: Emergency dental treatment overseas is covered under TRAVEL-4.4.

text: My house suffered damage during a severe storm with 120 km/h winds. The roof was partially torn off and windows were broken. I have photos and council reports.
notes: Storm damage is a standard insurable peril under building cover.

text: My car was damaged in a collision. The repair cost is $42000 but my sum insured is $35000. I have repair quotes and the accident report.
notes: Claim exceeds sum insured; only $35000 will be paid under the sum insured basis of cover.

text: My house was damaged in a severe storm. The repair cost is $38000 but my sum insured for buildings is $30000. I have repair quotes and damage photos.
notes: Claim exceeds sum insured; underinsurance provision applies and only $30000 will be paid.

text: I had to curtail my 4-week trip after 2 weeks due to a serious family illness requiring my return. I have medical certification and airline rebooking confirmation.
notes: Trip curtailment due to family illness is covered under TRAVEL-3.6.

text: My car was damaged when I hit a pothole on the road and blew out my tyre and damaged the suspension. I have photos of the pothole and repair quote.
notes: Accidental damage to vehicle from road hazard is covered under motor insurance.

text: A guest slipped on my bathroom floor and injured themselves. They are suing me for medical costs and lost wages totalling $25000.
notes: Premises liability may be covered but depends on whether policy includes liability cover and whether homeowner was negligent.

text: My suitcase was damaged by baggage handlers at the airport, rendering my clothes unwearable. The airline refused compensation. I have photos and airline incident report.
notes: Baggage damage is covered under TRAVEL-2.3 when caused by third-party negligence.

text: My furniture was damaged when I moved house and the removalists dropped a box. I have photos and the removalist's incident report.
My car was damaged when I failed to apply the handbrake properly and it rolled down a hill into a parked car. I have photos and the other driver's details.
I lost my phone while travelling in Japan and had to buy a replacement. I have the receipt and photos of where I lost it.
My bathroom tiles cracked due to a defect in installation by the builder. I am claiming for replacement of all tiles.
My car was stolen from my driveway overnight. I have the police report and have cooperated with the investigation.
I was injured while participating in an extreme sports activity (skydiving) during my trip. I have medical reports and proof of participation.
My front door lock stopped working after 10 years of use. I am claiming for replacement of the lock mechanism.
My car was damaged in a collision with a third party who has now gone bankrupt and cannot pay. I have the court judgment.
My trip was cancelled after my employer unexpectedly terminated my employment 2 weeks before departure. I have the termination letter.
My house was damaged when a construction vehicle from a neighbouring worksite crashed into my fence and damaged the foundation. I have photos and the contractor's details.
